# AIBgin — an AIB for schools (in development)
> An AIB for schools that builds on what each student already knows. AIBgin is in development, built on AIB.core, the core behind AIBEVA.

## Key facts
- Status: in development. Not yet available. Everything below is our goal, not a finished feature.
- Idea: an intelligent being for each student that builds on what the student already knows.
- Safety is part of the core: the Guardian layer (AIBguardian) inside; roles for school and family; designed in the EU around the EU AI Act and GDPR.
- Interested for your school? info@aiblab.info
- AIBEVA (for adults, 18+) is available for Windows today, with no subscription: https://aibeva.com/download
- Operator: SAY TO PAY s.r.o. (AIBlab), Ostrava, Czech Republic, EU · Company ID 086 94 222 · on the market since 2019
